dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale-grey to buff edges along folded flight feathers providing high contrast against dark brown feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct horizontal boundary transition from the uniform dark-brown crown to the scaly textured mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast black facial mask originating at the base of the bill, encompassing the eye, and extending into the malar/throat region.
